items.title: Update binding verification to slim protocol in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the binding verification process to align with the slim protocol, eliminating the requirement for JWT signatures. Key changes include decoding single-segment bindings and retaining field comparisons to ensure device authenticity. The adjustments enhance session establishment reliability and maintain trust in attestation epochs.

items.title: Enhance Reddit Comment Verification in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the verification process for Reddit comments by eliminating guesswork in response parsing. Instead of assuming outcomes, the system now checks recent comments to confirm if a write was successful, reducing the risk of duplicate submissions. Key changes include stricter matching criteria and enhanced error handling to ensure clarity in reporting outcomes.

items.title: Fix relay handling of device acknowledgment/error frames in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses issues with the relay incorrectly closing connections due to unsupported message types. Key changes include allowing additional message types from the device and ensuring the BROWSER_SESSION_ENABLED flag is set correctly in the deployment configuration. The fix enhances session stability and prevents premature disconnections during the session handshake.

items.title: Enhance Run Management in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new mechanism to handle orphaned scheduled runs caused by worker restarts. Key changes include the implementation of a reaper function to clean up stale runs and adjustments to the indexing strategy in MongoDB for improved performance. Additionally, the cutoff time for run termination has been increased to 45 minutes to reduce false positives in run status.

items.title: Fix session routing for browser commands in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the session interface by adding the missing '/v1' prefix to the routing paths, resolving 404 errors encountered during E2E tests. Additionally, the related test cases have been updated to align with the new routing structure, ensuring that the CI pipeline accurately reflects the current implementation. All tests are passing successfully.

items.title: Streamline Account Name Display in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update unifies the display of account names in the connections sidebar, resolving inconsistencies caused by multiple logic sources. Now, all account names will follow a single format derived from `label`, `profile.name`, `login`, or `email`, eliminating visual clutter and confusion. The changes have been validated against real production data, ensuring a clean and consistent user interface.

items.title: Enhance Auto Top-Up Page with Card Re-Addition Info in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update adds a persistent alert at the top of the auto top-up page, informing users that previously saved cards are no longer valid due to a change in the payment account. The alert provides clear instructions on re-adding cards to restore auto top-up functionality while ensuring that existing settings remain intact. The changes have been localized in multiple languages to enhance user experience.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Run Feedback in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature that displays whether a scheduled run achieved its goal, based on tool execution records. Key changes include the addition of 'outcome' and 'outcome_reason' fields in the IScheduledRun interface, and updates to the UI to reflect these outcomes with appropriate color coding. This enhancement aims to improve user understanding of task success rates and provide clearer feedback.

items.title: Enhance Goal Achievement Judgement in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new outcome judging mechanism that determines whether a run achieved the user's goal based on tool execution evidence rather than relying on the model's self-report. Key changes include the addition of a dedicated outcome judge service and modifications to various handlers and persistence layers to support this functionality. This enhancement aims to reduce false success rates and improve the reliability of task outcomes.

items.title: Fix schema resolution issues for Skill activation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the xiaohongshu Skill could not be activated due to unresolved schema references. The solution involves inlining `$ref` pointers in the facade input schemas, ensuring they are correctly resolved during compilation. All affected facades have been validated, resulting in zero discrepancies in acceptance testing.

items.title: Publisher Decommissioning Completed Successfully in Index 🚀
items.summary: The decommissioning of the Publisher has been fully executed across all 7 phases, with this PR documenting the final step of dropping tables and providing verification evidence. Key results include all internal interfaces returning 404, successful API calls, and no residual data in Kubernetes clusters, ensuring a clean transition and system integrity.

items.title: Final Step: Dropping Publish Tables in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This PR completes the decommissioning of the publish center by removing eight publish-related tables from the database. All necessary preconditions have been verified, including data backups and the absence of active consumers. The changes ensure a clean removal without impacting other database elements, following the correct foreign key dependency order.

items.title: Enhance Task Retrieval with Actor Identity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the task retrieval process by scoping access to the actor-injected identity, ensuring that users can only access their own tasks. Key changes include the introduction of `actor_user_id` in the identity keys and modifications to the task listing logic to prevent unauthorized access. The implementation has been thoroughly tested, achieving full test coverage with 202 passed and 11 skipped.

items.title: Enhance long video rendering efficiency in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where long video renders were prematurely detached due to a 600s Bash timeout, leading to excessive turn consumption. Key changes include increasing the Bash timeout to 30 minutes and updating documentation to emphasize the importance of executing long commands within a single Bash call. These adjustments aim to optimize resource usage and improve overall rendering success rates.

items.title: Streamline Account Management Experience in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the user experience by consolidating action buttons into a dropdown menu when connected, ensuring a cleaner interface. Additionally, the redundant account naming prompt has been removed, allowing users to proceed directly to authorization without unnecessary steps. These changes improve usability and reduce confusion during account management.

items.title: Enhance Payment Methods for Revenue Analysis in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update integrates the newly added Card payment method into the revenue analysis page, ensuring all payment options are consistently displayed. Key changes include the unification of payment method sources and localization improvements across multiple languages. Additionally, several bugs related to payment method filtering and display have been resolved, enhancing the overall user experience.

items.title: Cleanup and Decommission of PlatformPublisher in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update finalizes the decommissioning of the PlatformPublisher submodule, removing all related references and documentation. Key changes include the removal of the submodule from `.gitmodules`, updates to AGENTS.md, and archiving of relevant plans. The repository for PlatformPublisher has been archived, ensuring a clean transition and maintaining necessary backup records.

items.title: Fix image offset issues and add checks in Skills 🛠️
items.summary: This update addresses two critical defects found during the latest review. The first defect involved incorrect image offsets due to inconsistent line parsing, which could lead to data loss. The second defect removed essential checks for unclosed HTML tags, risking the inclusion of external image URLs in published content. Both issues have been resolved with robust validation measures.

items.title: Refactor auto-topup to use Card payment method in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the frontend with backend changes by switching the auto-topup payment method from Stripe to Card. Key adjustments ensure that even with old cached bundles, users will not create configurations that bypass payment. The implementation has been verified with no errors in `vue-tsc` and a clean eslint report.

items.title: Refactor auto-topup to use Card payment method in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the auto-topup feature to record off-session top-ups as Card payments instead of Stripe, aligning with the current account structure. Key changes include updating the default payment method to Card, implementing a migration to convert existing Stripe records, and ensuring that the payment process is streamlined without interruptions. All tests have passed, confirming the stability of the changes.

items.title: Enhance Kuaishou Connector Documentation in Index 🚧
items.summary: This update solidifies the application checklist and real-world status for the Kuaishou connector in the documentation. Key changes include a revised status indicating blockage due to enterprise qualification requirements, new sections comparing Kuaishou with Douyin, and a decision table for enterprise registration. Additionally, the order of operations has been clarified to prevent confusion during implementation.

items.title: Streamlined Browser Tool Activation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the browser tool activation process by removing the server-side `BrowserOperationDescriptor`, allowing for a more efficient skill activation flow. Key changes include prioritizing server fields for `browser_authority` and improving the parsing logic for skills, ensuring all necessary capabilities are correctly interpreted. The modifications have been validated with real-world skills, confirming successful parsing and functionality.

items.title: Fix Kuaishou Connector Entry in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update cherry-picks the Kuaishou connector entry into the main branch, ensuring it is now included in the connectors.yaml file with the necessary hidden flag. Additionally, the test suite has been updated to reflect the new connector count, enhancing error reporting with improved identifier visibility. All tests have passed successfully.

items.title: Removed Deprecated Publisher Guides and OpenAPI in Docs 📚
items.summary: This update removes the publisher guides and OpenAPI documentation following the decommissioning of the publisher service. Key changes include the deletion of five markdown files related to publisher guides and the removal of the OpenAPI JSON file. The navigation structure has also been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring no references to the now-defunct service remain.

items.title: Fix comment reporting issue in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a bug where successfully created comments were incorrectly reported as unknown outcomes. The changes ensure that comments are validated correctly, even when certain fields are missing, and introduces a new command to verify comments before retrying. Additionally, several risks were addressed to enhance the reliability of the comment submission process.

items.title: Sunset of Materials Tools in M C Ps 🌅
items.summary: The materials tools have been removed following the decommissioning of the publishing center. This includes the deletion of `acedatacloud_list_channels` and `acedatacloud_search_materials`, which now return 404 errors due to the retirement of the `PublishMaterial` directory. Content distribution will now be handled through Connector and Skills, enhancing user experience by allowing direct AI publishing after account authorization.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI CLI with New Features in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the OpenAI CLI with the latest API documentation, introducing new commands like 'speech' and 'realtime'. Key enhancements include expanded request options for 'chat', improved binary response handling, and shared JSON parsing helpers. Documentation has been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring users have access to the latest functionalities.

items.title: Enhance Task Outcome Accuracy in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a robust system for automatically determining the outcomes of scheduled tasks, addressing previous issues with false success reports. Key changes include a new classification system for task completion, enhanced data storage for task results, and improved API responses to ensure accurate tracking of task statuses. These improvements aim to provide users with reliable feedback and streamline the task management process.

items.title: Add 51CTO Blog Connector in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new connector for the 51CTO blog, allowing users to capture login cookies using the ACE plugin. The integration is seamless, requiring no OAuth adapter or migration, and will be automatically synced via the connector catalog. The implementation has passed validation for all connection methods and includes clear documentation on usage.

items.title: New 51CTO Blog Drafting Skill in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new skill for creating Markdown drafts on the 51CTO blog using users' own login cookies. The implementation relies solely on standard libraries, ensuring compatibility without third-party dependencies. Key features include a gated draft creation process and comprehensive error handling to enhance security and reliability.

items.title: Retire Publish Center and APIs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update officially retires the Publish Center, removing all related models, APIs, and workflows. Key changes include the deletion of over 5,000 lines of code, including models and routes, and the successful backup of all associated data. The migration process has been structured to ensure data integrity while preparing for future database adjustments.

items.title: Updated Douyin Video Posting Guidelines in Index 🚀
items.summary: This PR revises the conclusions regarding video posting capabilities on Douyin, stating that server-side automatic submissions are not feasible, while H5 semi-automatic submissions are allowed. Key changes include the removal of misleading application guidelines and the clarification of supported scopes based on official documentation. The updates aim to ensure compliance and prevent user confusion regarding the capabilities available for Douyin integration.

items.title: Enhance Toutiao Connector with Required Skills in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds the necessary `required_skills` to the Toutiao connector, enabling users to utilize skills effectively after connecting their accounts. The changes ensure that skills are automatically installed during connection, resolving previous routing issues. This aligns the Toutiao connector with existing implementations for other platforms like CSDN and Juejin.

items.title: Empower Users to Read and Publish on 今日头条 in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new skill for the 今日头条 platform, allowing users to read and publish articles using their own login cookies. Key features include article listing, detailed statistics, and a robust publishing process that ensures images are uploaded correctly. The implementation relies solely on standard libraries, ensuring compatibility with existing sandbox environments.

items.title: Fix Bilibili Article Publishing Issues in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical bugs in the Bilibili article publishing process. It ensures that the correct article URL is returned instead of a draft ID, fixes the hardcoded category issue, and clarifies the submission status to prevent confusion about published articles. Comprehensive testing has confirmed the effectiveness of these changes.

items.title: Fix misplaced Blogger section comment for clarity in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update relocates a misplaced comment in the connectors.yaml file, ensuring that the Blogger section is correctly positioned outside the WordPress entry. The change is purely cosmetic, with no impact on functionality or configuration. All YAML structures remain intact and properly formatted.

items.title: Enhance YouTube Upload Documentation in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the YouTube upload documentation by adding a section on handling CDN URLs instead of local files. Key changes include clearer instructions for downloading videos and better error handling during uploads. The modifications ensure users receive accurate feedback on upload failures, enhancing the overall user experience.

items.title: Fix browser transfer verification process in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the browser transfer verification method to align with the Browser Relay approach, ensuring that the binding sent by aichat2 is properly validated against live connection data. Key changes include decoding the base64url binding and real-time parsing of device and connection epochs, which prevents unauthorized access. The identity of the caller remains secured through a shared internal token.

items.title: Fix broken execution chain in Platform Service 🔧
items.summary: This update addresses a critical broken execution chain caused by recent changes, ensuring that the browser Skill can now correctly connect and function. Key modifications include the replacement of outdated API calls with the current `browser-capabilities/select`, and the introduction of a new `LocalBrowserAuthorityClient` to verify session bindings without relying on a removed issuer. Overall, this enhances the reliability and security of the connection process.

items.title: Enhance Browser Capabilities with Policy Details in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the serialization of `policy_digest`, `policy_revision`, and `method_id` in the `browser-capabilities/select` endpoint. These additions enable downstream systems to construct session bindings effectively without altering existing field semantics. The changes have been validated through comprehensive tests and checks.

items.title: Enhance Midjourney Error Classification in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the classification of errors from the Midjourney API, ensuring that upstream moderation and capacity issues are accurately reported. Key changes include the expansion of the shared keywords list for error handling across multiple handlers, which will reduce false alarms in the alert system. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the error classification logic.

items.title: Upgrade Python Setup Action to Version 7 in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the actions/setup-python from version 5 to 7, enhancing the workflow with improved dependency management and bug fixes. Key changes include migration to ESM, removal of deprecated inputs, and better error handling for pip cache on Windows. These updates aim to streamline the CI process and enhance overall stability.

items.title: Center SVG Icons with Core Update in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update bumps the @acedatacloud/core package to version 0.19.0, resolving the issue of misaligned SVG icons in the application. Key pages have been verified to show icons centered correctly, improving the overall user interface. The changes ensure that the application adheres to the latest styling standards without introducing any breaking changes.

items.title: Update Google Ads Skill to Latest API Version in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue of the Google Ads skill using a deprecated API version, v18, which has been sunsetted. The skill has been upgraded to use v25, ensuring functionality and preventing 404 errors. Additionally, the documentation has been improved to clarify the necessary headers and conditions for successful API calls.

items.title: Enhance WordPress Skill for SEO and Publishing in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update strengthens the WordPress skill by addressing several critical bugs and enhancing SEO capabilities. Key improvements include the addition of necessary SEO fields, a fail-closed mechanism to prevent duplicate slugs, and adjustments to ensure proper publishing functionality. All changes have been verified in a real WordPress environment, ensuring robust performance for unattended publishing.

items.title: Enhance Reddit Marketing Prompts for Manual Review in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive manual review prompt guide for Reddit marketing, enhancing the capabilities of the Reddit connector. Key changes include the addition of two prompts: one for daily topic scanning and another for manual post replies, ensuring compliance with Reddit's guidelines. The implementation aims to improve user engagement while maintaining safety and effectiveness in promotional activities.

items.title: Add KUAISHOU_TOKEN mapping for Kuaishou connector in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the mapping for KUAISHOU_TOKEN in the Kuaishou connector, ensuring that the skill can read the correct token. Previously, the absence of this mapping caused the provider to fallback to an unused variable, leading to skill failures. The changes have been validated with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Launch Kuaishou Video Publishing Skills in Skills 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces a new Kuaishou connector that allows users to publish videos and read their works through the Kuaishou open platform. Key features include a three-step video upload process, security measures for content originality, and a streamlined interface using standard libraries. The implementation has been thoroughly tested, ensuring reliability and performance.

items.title: New Kuaishou Connector Entry Added in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new Kuaishou connector entry in the connectors.yaml file, marked as hidden until specific prerequisites are met. Key changes include the addition of three scopes for user permissions and the injection of the KUAISHOU_OAUTH_APP_ID into the platform environment. Additionally, the test connection method schema has been updated to reflect accurate counts and improve error reporting.

items.title: Introducing Kuaishou OAuth Adapter in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds a new OAuth adapter for the Kuaishou platform, enabling seamless integration with its official Open API. Key changes include the addition of the KuaishouAdapter class, modifications to connection handling, and enhancements to token management. The implementation ensures that the adapter operates without blocking on approvals, utilizing mock tests for validation.

items.title: Multi-Account Plan Update: PR-6 Invalidated, Access Lifted in Index 🚀
items.summary: The status of the multi-account plan has been updated, with PR-6 now invalidated following the merge of PlatformFrontend#928, which removed key files. This change automatically lifts the hard access restriction previously tied to PR-6, allowing PR-4 to proceed without waiting. The correctness of account selection for publishing will now be ensured by PR-7.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Tasks with Account Selection in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the ability for users to select specific accounts for scheduled tasks associated with connectors that have multiple accounts. The UI will only display the account selection dropdown when multiple accounts are available, ensuring that tasks consistently use the designated account. Additionally, a field name mismatch has been corrected to align with the backend contract.

items.title: Enhance Multi-Account Support on Connection Page in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a revamped connection page that supports multiple accounts, allowing users to add new accounts, set defaults, and rename them. Key changes include a new 'Add Account' feature and improved UI elements that only display additional account options when necessary. The update ensures that existing functionalities remain intact, preventing accidental data overwrites during account management.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Tasks with Account Binding in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the ability for scheduled tasks to specify which account of a connector to use, ensuring consistency in task execution. Key changes include the addition of `connection_bindings[]` to the `unattended_policy`, allowing for precise account selection while maintaining default behavior for interactive chats. The implementation also addresses previous issues with account selection persistence and enhances security checks for binding validation.

items.title: Enhance Multi-Account Support for Connectors in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces support for multiple accounts per connector, allowing users to bind several accounts to a single connector. Key changes include the addition of new fields in the model for account management and a partial unique index to ensure only one default account per connector. The API has been updated to accommodate these changes, enhancing user experience while maintaining existing behaviors.

items.title: Clean Up Orphan Key in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update removes the orphan key `menu.publishIndex` from the Nexior project, as it was not being utilized by any components despite existing translations in 18 locales. The key was part of the retired publishing center feature, which has been fully removed from the PlatformFrontend. This change ensures a cleaner codebase without impacting any user interfaces.

items.title: Sunsetting the Publishing Center in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update officially removes the Publishing Center, including related pages, operators, and internationalization files. Users will now access capabilities through the Connector and Skills at the new entry point. Additionally, old links are redirected to the application list to prevent empty views from appearing.

items.title: Add Douyin OAuth Adapter for Video Posting in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new OAuth adapter for Douyin, enabling server-side video submissions through its OpenAPI. Key components include the adapter implementation, comprehensive testing with 18 new tests, and necessary adjustments to settings for OAuth client keys. The framework remains unchanged, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.

items.title: Douyin Video Upload API Validated in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update confirms the feasibility of using Douyin's server-side video upload OpenAPI, aligning it with the existing TikTok connector. Key changes include the addition of a new Douyin documentation file and updates to the marketing distribution documentation. The API endpoints have been verified to be online, enhancing our capabilities beyond TikTok's current offerings.

items.title: Fix Habr Cookie Connector to Load Skills in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue with the Habr cookie connector, which previously had an empty required_skills array, rendering it unusable. Key changes include adding the necessary required_skills to both the method and top-level in connectors.yaml, and introducing new tests to ensure proper functionality. The fix ensures that the Habr connector can now correctly load its associated skill, improving its usability.

items.title: Fix email footer locale mismatch in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the unsubscribe link in the email preview footer displayed in the console's UI language instead of the email's locale. Key changes include updating the unsubscribe text to follow the email's locale and ensuring the sender address is dynamically set rather than hardcoded. These adjustments enhance the accuracy of email previews without affecting sent emails.

items.title: Enhance Reddit Search Defaults for Better Relevance in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update changes the default sorting method for the Reddit search command from 'new' to 'relevance', addressing issues where recent posts were returned without keyword relevance. The time filter default is also adjusted from 'week' to 'month' to provide a broader context for search results. Additionally, documentation has been updated to clarify the intended use of the sorting options.

items.title: New Connectors for Yuque, Oschina, and SegmentFault in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new connectors for Chinese content platforms: Yuque, Oschina, and SegmentFault. These connectors allow seamless integration without the need for OAuth adapters or migrations, as they will be automatically synced via the `auth-backend-connector-catalog-sync`. Key features include user token support for Yuque and cookie-based authentication for the other two platforms.

items.title: New Connectors for Chinese Platforms in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new connectors for Chinese content platforms: Yuque, OSChina, and SegmentFault. Each connector operates using standard libraries without third-party dependencies, ensuring seamless integration. Key features include dry-run write operations and explicit confirmation for publishing, enhancing user control and security.

items.title: Restore Inline SVG Display for Centered Icons in Common Frontend 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the display issue of inline SVGs caused by Tailwind's preflight settings, which previously rendered SVGs as block elements, disrupting their alignment. The solution ensures that all SVGs are displayed as inline-block, allowing them to be properly centered within their parent containers. Additionally, the changes include updates to the README and tests to validate the fix across various scenarios.

items.title: Enhance Reddit Skill with Commenting and Search Features in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new commands to the Reddit skill: `comment`, `search`, and `subreddit-info`. Users can now reply to posts, search for public threads, and access subreddit rules, significantly enhancing interaction capabilities. The changes also include improved safety measures for write operations and comprehensive testing to ensure functionality.

items.title: Retiring Publish Center Pathways in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update marks the first step in the decommissioning of the Publish Center, freezing write paths and disabling scheduled tasks. Key changes include modifying API responses to return a 410 status for deprecated endpoints while keeping read access intact. Additionally, admin models have been set to read-only, ensuring no new entries can be added or modified during this transition.

items.title: Streamline OAuth Client Registry Management in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a structured YAML manifest for managing first-party OAuth clients, addressing issues caused by manual entries in production. The new sync command ensures that duplicate client IDs and redirect URIs are flagged, preventing potential OAuth flow failures. Additionally, comprehensive tests have been added to validate the functionality and maintain integrity across deployments.

items.title: Fix OAuth Client IDs for Maestro and Grok in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves OAuth authorization failures for the Maestro and Grok connectors by assigning them their own unique client IDs. Previously, both were incorrectly using client IDs from other MCPs, leading to authorization errors. The changes ensure that each MCP has distinct client IDs, preventing future conflicts and maintaining user access.

items.title: Refactor fish_audio_meta.py to EntryPoint Skill in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: The fish_audio_meta.py script has been successfully moved from the agent's directory to the entrypoint scripts within the skills folder. This change enhances the organization of skill-related helpers and ensures that the script is bundled correctly in the sandbox environment. All references have been updated accordingly, and extensive testing confirms that the functionality remains intact.

items.title: Enhance aichat CLI with New Parameters in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update syncs the `aichat` CLI `chat2` command with the latest OpenAPI specifications, introducing new parameters such as `application_id`, `allowed_skills`, `allowed_mcp_servers`, `offset`, and `limit`. These enhancements allow for more flexible and controlled interactions with the `/aichat2/conversations` endpoint, improving user experience and functionality.

items.title: Enhance Video Processing Efficiency in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a shared helper for video clip processing and addresses timeout issues in the Maestro system. Key changes include a new asynchronous task script that improves video submission and polling, reducing processing time significantly. Additionally, the rendering budget has been clarified to prevent unnecessary re-renders, optimizing resource usage.

items.title: Fix black screen issue caused by missing GSAP in Platform Service 🎨
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where rendered videos appeared as a black screen due to a missing GSAP script. The fix involves seeding the GSAP file into project directories that reference it, ensuring that animations can load correctly. Additionally, safeguards have been implemented to prevent similar issues in the future, enhancing the overall stability of the rendering process.

items.title: Revamping Kuaishou Connector Strategy in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new approach for the Kuaishou connector, advocating the use of the official Open API with OAuth instead of cookie-based methods. Key changes include the addition of a comprehensive document outlining the API endpoints and necessary permissions for compliance. This shift aims to enhance user experience and ensure adherence to platform regulations.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Task Logs Retrieval in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds a new section to the documentation for the `retrieve_runs_batch` feature, which allows users to fetch all scheduled task run records without specifying an ID. The records are returned in reverse chronological order and include task names, with options for filtering by status and pagination. Additionally, a risk identified during review was addressed by correcting the response examples to ensure clarity.

items.title: New 'Runs' Tab Added to Scheduled Tasks in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new 'Runs' tab to the scheduled tasks page, providing a comprehensive overview of all scheduled runs sorted by time. Users can filter runs by status and easily navigate to the corresponding tasks. The change enhances usability and ensures real-time updates for ongoing tasks.

items.title: Complete Decommissioning Plan for Publisher Center in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive plan for the decommissioning of the Publisher Center, detailing a seven-phase approach to remove the service entirely. Key changes include the addition of a detailed README outlining the steps for backup, service suspension, and eventual deletion of associated resources. The impact of this plan is expected to streamline operations and eliminate unused APIs, ensuring a more efficient system moving forward.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Task History with Cross-Task Querying in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `retrieve_runs_batch` action, allowing users to fetch all scheduled task run records sorted by time. The new functionality supports filtering by status and pagination, enhancing the user experience on the Nexior platform. Key changes include updates to several persistence files and the addition of comprehensive tests to ensure reliability.

items.title: Streamlined Stripe Webhook Handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update consolidates the Stripe webhook handling by removing the secondary signing secret, simplifying the codebase. The `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is now mandatory, ensuring that any absence leads to explicit failures rather than silent errors. Additionally, outdated comments and references to the deprecated account have been cleaned up, enhancing code clarity and maintainability.

items.title: Enhance Connector Multi-Account Support in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces comprehensive documentation for enabling multiple accounts per connector, addressing a significant limitation in the current system. Key changes include the addition of fields for labeling, default account selection, and enhanced task scheduling capabilities. The implementation plan is divided into seven PRs across various repositories, ensuring a smooth rollout of these features.

items.title: Fix YouTube Token Injection Issue in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the YouTube skill was failing due to a missing token mapping in the provider environment variables. The mapping for 'google/youtube' to 'GOOGLE_YOUTUBE_TOKEN' has been added, ensuring that the skill can now authenticate properly. Additionally, a new test has been implemented to automatically verify provider mappings, enhancing the robustness of the system.

items.title: Revamped Installation and Service Docs in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update significantly enhances the installation and service documentation for Coding Bridge. Key changes include a comprehensive install matrix for various package managers and a detailed service section that outlines commands, unit locations, and troubleshooting steps. These improvements aim to provide users with clearer guidance and ensure a smoother setup experience.

items.title: Enable Browser Execution for Aichat2 and Relay in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update activates the browser execution switch for Aichat2 and browser-relay, facilitating end-to-end acceptance testing for the Xiaohongshu platform. Key changes include setting `BROWSER_EXECUTION_ENABLED` and `BROWSER_TOOL_EXECUTION_ENABLED` to true, while ensuring existing service behaviors remain unaffected without proper device connections. A kill switch is also implemented for easy deactivation if needed.

items.title: Streamlined Browser Authority Layer in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the authority grant layer from the Browser Device Bridge, significantly reducing code complexity. Key changes include the deletion of several files related to browser authority and the introduction of a new contract file for device pairing. The migration only drops three isolated tables, ensuring that essential functionalities remain intact.

items.title: Fix auto-topup card binding with single Stripe key in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical bug that disabled the auto-recharge card binding form due to a missing Stripe publishable key. The logic for selecting keys has been simplified, and the key is now injected during the build process to ensure proper account binding. Additionally, the form will clearly indicate when it is disabled due to a missing key, enhancing user experience.

items.title: Streamline Stripe Payment Functions in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the payment processing by removing the multi-account handling for Stripe, simplifying the payment functions. Key changes include the deletion of the `account` parameter from six payment functions and the removal of related configurations, resulting in a cleaner codebase with approximately 71 lines removed. All tests passed successfully, ensuring stability in the payment workflow.

items.title: Refactor(stripe): drop multi-account plumbing, single Stripe account in Pay Backend 🧹
Fix hero action buttons for long labels in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue of hero action buttons being clipped due to fixed widths. The `.action-button` class has been modified to use `min-width` instead of a fixed width, allowing buttons to adapt to longer translated labels while maintaining visual consistency. Similar adjustments were made to other buttons to ensure a cohesive user experience across the platform.

items.title: Feat(growth): 增长看板接通真实 utm 漏斗 (P0-1) in Index ✨
Fix(seo): render JSON-LD + legal page content for crawlers under SSR in Frontend Web 🐛
Fix(ssr): emit per-route canonical/OG/JSON-LD inside <head> in Frontend Web 🐛
Enhance SEO with Sitemap and Robots.txt Fixes in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the sitemap namespace and adds the missing /documents index page, ensuring better visibility for crawlers. Additionally, the robots.txt file has been updated to explicitly allow AI and GEO crawlers while disallowing indexing of sensitive order pages. These changes enhance the site's SEO performance and improve crawler interactions.

items.title: Docs(marketing): 修正 connector-marketing-engine 的过期/错误断言 in Index 📝
Chore(email): let the secret control ALLOW_REAL_RECIPIENTS, require postal address in Backend ✨
Update Python Dependencies for Enhanced Performance in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the `djangorestframework` from version 3.15.1 to 3.17.1, introducing several bug fixes and new features, including support for Python 3.14 and Django 6.0. Additionally, the `tencentcloud-sdk-python` has been updated from 3.1.135 to 3.1.140, ensuring compatibility with the latest enhancements and fixes.

items.title: Fix(email-marketing): console copy still claimed opt-in after the opt-out switch in Frontend Web 🐛
Update auto-topup to use HK Stripe account in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update configures the auto-topup feature to save and charge new cards on the HK Stripe account, as the US account is being phased out. Existing configurations will retain their stored accounts until users re-bind. The change has been applied live and verified, ensuring the manifest is consistent with the current deployment.

items.title: Seal US Stripe Account for HK Payments in Pay Backend 🚀
items.summary: The US Stripe account has been decommissioned, and all money-in transactions are now forced to the HK account. This change ensures that no payments can be processed through the US account, enhancing security and reliability. The configuration has been verified in production to prevent any fallback to the US account.

items.title: Streamlined Browser Device Bridge Progress in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update documents the progress on the Browser Device Bridge, highlighting the deletion of approximately 4,600 lines related to the digest mechanism, with CI tests passing successfully. Additionally, the scope of PR-4 has been refined to retain five shared authority tables, ensuring device pairing remains intact while only four authority-only tables will be deleted. For detailed changes, refer to the updated plan.

items.title: Streamlined Browser Integration by Removing Digest Gates in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the Browser Device Bridge by removing the `wire_contract_digest` and `facade_catalog_digest` gates from Nexior. Key changes include the deletion of the generated browser contract module and the compatibility check, while retaining the execution FSM and state validation. The overall impact is a cleaner codebase with improved performance and reduced risk of errors.

items.title: Streamlined Contract Generation with Handwritten Protocol in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the previously generated 3.5k lines of contract code with a hand-authored protocol, significantly reducing complexity while maintaining functionality. Key components such as command handling and capability checks remain intact, ensuring no loss in performance. The overall codebase is cleaner, with a net reduction of 3,610 lines across 13 files.

items.title: Streamline Browser Relay by Removing Unused Digest in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unnecessary `wire_contract_digest` from the Browser Device Bridge, retaining only the essential `machine_states`. Key changes include the introduction of a hand-authored `MACHINE_STATES` and the deletion of the generated `browser_contract_generated.py` file. The modifications enhance efficiency while maintaining compatibility with existing systems.

items.title: Streamlined Browser Device Bridge for aichat2 in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update significantly reduces the complexity of the Browser Device Bridge by removing the custom manifest generator and associated digest checks. Key files, including the generator script and the large generated contract file, have been eliminated, leading to a cleaner codebase while maintaining the integrity of the core capabilities. The manifest remains intact, ensuring compatibility and functionality are preserved.

items.title: Enhance Package Bump Workflow in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update allows the `workflow_dispatch` event to trigger the package bump process, ensuring that manual runs can publish fresh CalVer versions. Additionally, a concurrency group has been added to prevent race conditions during concurrent publish runs, maintaining the integrity of the release process. The changes ensure that the tap and bucket remain up-to-date without backfilling older versions.

items.title: Fix negative pricing display to show positive net rates in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the display of cached token prices on the OpenAI pricing page, ensuring they show positive net rates instead of misleading negative values. Key changes include the introduction of a new helper function to calculate the true net cached price and the addition of missing i18n keys for better localization support. These improvements enhance user experience and clarity in pricing representation.

items.title: Enhance Auto-Topup with Account-Specific Stripe Keys in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces account-specific publishable keys for the auto-topup feature, ensuring that Stripe.js is initialized with the correct key based on the user's account. Key changes include a hard-fail mechanism for mismatched keys and improved handling of SetupIntent responses. The implementation enhances security and reliability for card saves, preventing silent failures and ensuring compliance with Stripe's requirements.

items.title: Enhance Auto-Topup with HK Stripe Support in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces account-aware saved-card recharge for auto-topup, allowing transactions to be processed through the HK Stripe account instead of the default US account. Key changes include the addition of a new `stripe_account` column in the database and modifications to payment handling to ensure the correct account is used for new and existing cards. The migration is complete with all tests passing, ensuring a smooth transition.

items.title: Enhanced Stripe Integration with Account-Aware Auto-Topup in Pay Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a robust Stripe integration that ensures all money-in transactions are routed to the correct account, effectively decommissioning the US account. Key features include account-aware auto-topup and a kill-switch for the US account, enhancing security and compliance. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the new routing logic and ensure fail-safe operations.

items.title: Clean Up Legacy Names in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors local variable names to remove any references to V1, enhancing code clarity. The variables `x_payment_data` and `legacy_requirements` have been renamed to `payment_data` and `base_requirements`, respectively, with no functional changes. All tests have passed successfully, ensuring stability in the payment path.

items.title: Fix component registration for email marketing tables in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves issues with the rendering of the email marketing components by ensuring that all necessary Element Plus components are properly imported and registered. The `AudienceRecipientTable` and `AudienceProfileDrawer` components now include all required imports, allowing for correct display of the table and drawer elements. Testing confirms that the components function as expected without any errors.

items.title: Run the main daemon as a user-scoped OS service in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `coding-bridge service` command, allowing users to manage the main daemon as a background OS service across platforms. It supports installation, starting, stopping, and uninstalling the service without requiring root access, ensuring user credentials remain intact. Comprehensive tests confirm functionality across Linux, macOS, and Windows, enhancing usability and reliability.

items.title: Update Legacy Payment Header to v2 in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update migrates all documentation for the x402 server from the outdated `X-Payment` header to the new `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header. A total of 11 files were modified to ensure clarity and accuracy, eliminating any references to the deprecated header. This change enhances the documentation's reliability for users interacting with the v2 API.

items.title: Revamping Marketing Strategy with Connector Ecosystem in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive marketing strategy leveraging the connector ecosystem to enhance AceDataCloud's outreach. Key documents have been added, including a current state overview, connector capability maximization, and execution plans. The findings reveal a significant underutilization of existing distribution channels, prompting a focused effort to activate and optimize these resources for better marketing outcomes.

items.title: Align Default Timeout with Official SDK in X402 Client 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the default `maxTimeoutSeconds` from 120 to 3600, aligning with the official x402 SDK. It also enhances documentation in the READMEs to reflect compliance with x402 v2 standards, including the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header and CAIP-2 networks. All tests have passed, confirming that the changes maintain functionality and security.

items.title: Enhance SDK Parity Guard for EVM Signer in X402 Client 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the official `x402` SDK as a development dependency and implements a parity guard to ensure that X402Client's hand-rolled EVM envelope aligns with the official specifications. Key changes include new tests that verify structural equivalence and document known divergences, reducing risks for future migrations. The CI remains stable with the addition of the new dependency.

items.title: Enhance Drift Guard for x402 Wire Dicts in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a drift guard for the Gateway's hand-built x402 wire dicts, ensuring compliance with the V2 specification. Key changes include the addition of tests that verify all required fields are present and that only expected fields are included. The implementation aims to prevent silent failures in payment processing due to schema mismatches, enhancing overall reliability.

items.title: Comprehensive Compliance Audit Findings and Tracker in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update documents the results of the 4-way x402 compliance audit following the V2-only consolidation. Key findings include the completion of the official SDK migration, confirmation of V2 compliance for the Gateway with minor deviations, and the establishment of a follow-up tracker for future enhancements. The audit ensures that pricing and coverage are accurate, setting a solid foundation for ongoing development.

items.title: Boost upload limits to 1000/hour for Nexior users in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update raises the upload cap for Nexior users from 100 to 1000 images per rolling hour, addressing the frequent 429 errors experienced by heavy users. The change involves modifying the file receipt TTL from 24 hours to 1 hour, ensuring a smoother upload experience without requiring complex migrations. The fix is verified to maintain existing functionality while enhancing performance for users uploading multiple images.

items.title: Revamp Operation Buttons for Risk Control Page in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: The operation buttons on the distribution risk page have been updated from link styles to more visually distinct entity buttons. This change enhances usability by ensuring buttons are clearly clickable, with adjustments made to button sizes and column widths to prevent text overflow. The modifications are purely stylistic, with no impact on the underlying logic or functionality.

items.title: Enhance Pricing Button with Alias URL and Bold Styling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the pricing button on the API docs page by linking it to a user-friendly alias URL instead of a UUID. Additionally, the button's styling has been upgraded from a ghost pill to a solid primary button, making it more visible and inviting for users. Internationalization support has also been added for all 12 locales, ensuring a consistent experience across languages.

items.title: Align Logout Icon with Label in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the alignment issue between the logout icon and its label in the sidebar. The logout element now uses the same grid structure as other menu items, ensuring consistent vertical alignment. The changes have been verified across desktop and mobile views, maintaining functionality and accessibility standards.

items.title: Update Sidebar Menu to 'Models & Pricing' in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: The sidebar menu on the console has been updated to reflect the accurate content of the models page, changing 'Model List' to 'Models & Pricing' across 12 languages. This change enhances clarity for users, indicating that the page includes both models and pricing information. The update involved no code changes, ensuring a seamless transition.

items.title: Enhance Analytics Layout for Clarity in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the layout of the analytics page by repositioning the date filters above the summary cards. Previously, users might have misunderstood the time range for the displayed metrics, as the filters were located below the cards. The change enhances user experience by making the filters more prominent and accessible.

items.title: Enhance row selection handling in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a safeguard in the email marketing recipient table to ensure that the toggleRowSelection function is only called when the table reference is ready. By implementing a check and retry mechanism, it prevents errors during the initial render, enhancing the stability of the campaign editor. The changes have been validated with successful tests and no eslint or type errors.

items.title: Enhance Image Editing Size Inference in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update fixes the issue where the `gpt-image-2` image editing feature returned a default 1:1 aspect ratio when no size was specified. The solution involves implementing size inference based on the input image's aspect ratio, ensuring that the output matches the intended dimensions. Key modifications were made across multiple handlers to support this functionality, along with comprehensive testing to validate the changes.

items.title: Enhance Tool Result Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves the issue of oversized tool results being truncated to a fixed 2000-character preview. Now, results are retained up to a specified ceiling of 20,000 characters, ensuring that larger outputs are fully represented. Key changes include a unified configuration for maximum result size and improvements to the serialization process to maintain accurate size reporting.

items.title: Fix video recovery issue in Platform Service 🎥
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where finished videos were incorrectly discarded due to a failure in the delivery detection process. The fix allows the system to recover nested bare MP4 files even when no manifest is present, ensuring that valid outputs are not lost. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate this behavior and ensure reliability.

items.title: Enhance error handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves error handling in the email marketing component by ensuring that the entire slot scope is guarded against undefined values. Changes were made to both the AudienceRecipientTable and AudienceProfileDrawer components to prevent console errors related to accessing properties of undefined. The fix maintains existing functionality while enhancing stability.

items.title: Revamp Email Marketing Opt-Out Model in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update transitions the email marketing strategy from an opt-in to an opt-out model for topic campaigns, allowing eligible users to receive emails unless they explicitly unsubscribe. Key changes include modifications to the eligible profiles query and email preparation logic to ensure compliance with subscription states. Additionally, several compliance issues identified during review have been addressed, enhancing the overall functionality and user experience.

items.title: Clarify Rendering Containers for Service Intro in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update revises the documentation to accurately describe how service intro pages render in both `.html-document-body` and `.markdown-body`. Key changes include clarifying button color rules to ensure consistency across both surfaces and preventing regression issues. The adjustments are purely documentation-focused, enhancing clarity for developers and avoiding future bugs.

items.title: Fix button text color for service intros in Backend 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where filled CTA buttons on the service intro pages displayed black text instead of white. By implementing container-agnostic CSS rules, the button text color is now consistently white across both service and documentation pages. The fix applies to the turnstile, discord-bot, and wechat-bot service intros, ensuring improved visibility and user experience.

items.title: Streamlining Browser Device Bridge for Efficiency in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive diagnosis and a streamlined PR plan aimed at reducing the complexity of the Browser Device Bridge. Key changes include the addition of two critical documents, archiving outdated designs, and updating the README to reflect the new simplified approach. The goal is to cut down the codebase from approximately 24,000 lines to under 6,000 lines, enhancing maintainability and performance.

items.title: Fix conformance test to be environment-independent in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a CI issue where the `/supported` conformance check failed due to the absence of a configured signer. By implementing a deterministic Base-only signer using `@override_settings`, the test now consistently returns a healthy V2 response, validating the response shape regardless of the environment. All tests have passed successfully, ensuring robust CI functionality.

items.title: Enhance x402 Documentation with Payment-Response Clarifications in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the x402 documentation regarding the optional `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header and introduces an optimal split-by-resource design. Key findings reveal that omitting the header has minimal impact, while the proposed tiers outline different approaches for handling receipts. The changes ensure compliance with the latest SDK specifications and improve clarity for developers.

items.title: Fix candidate preview to show real audience during pause in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a bug where the candidate preview would show an empty list when sending was paused, despite eligible profiles being available. The fix involves modifying the `eligible_profiles` function to allow real audience visibility during the preview while maintaining send restrictions. New tests have been added to ensure the functionality works as intended.

items.title: Fix recipient table crash on empty data in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug causing the Recipients table to crash when displaying empty or loading data. The fix involves changing the destructuring of the row property to use optional chaining, preventing errors when the scope is undefined. Additionally, the action column's fixed position has been removed to eliminate known triggers for this issue.

items.title: Align API Playground Tabs for a Sleeker Look in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the alignment issue of the 'Request' and 'Response' tabs in the API playground on the homepage. By changing the layout to inline-flex and adjusting the spacing, the icons now display neatly alongside the text. This enhancement improves the overall user experience and visual consistency.

items.title: Updated Card Pay-way Icon for Clarity in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update replaces the existing Card pay-way icon with a new, clearer bank-card graphic across the authenticated console order page and the anonymous public pay page. The change is purely a CSS asset URL swap, ensuring no logic or markup alterations. The new icon URL has been verified as reachable and functional.

items.title: Updated Card Pay-way Icon for Clarity in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update replaces the existing Card pay-way icon with a clearer bank-card graphic across two pages: the authenticated console order page and the anonymous public pay page. The change involves a simple asset URL swap in the scoped CSS, ensuring no logic or markup alterations. The new icon URL has been verified and is fully operational.

items.title: Align Icons in '为什么选择我们' Cards in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update centers the SVG icons in the '为什么选择我们' cards on the homepage, addressing a visual misalignment issue. The fix involved adjusting the CSS properties for the icon components to ensure they align properly with the text. No changes were made to the template or logic, and all tests passed successfully.

items.title: Documenting Key Design Decisions for Payment Responses in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update includes design notes for the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header and the restructuring of the payment state table. Key options for handling the response header have been outlined, with a recommendation for an async receipt pointer approach. Additionally, the proposal to move the payment state to a dedicated table is discussed, emphasizing the need for this change post-V2 stabilization.

items.title: Enhance Core-V2 Conformance Suite for Facilitator in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update ports the 53-case core-v2 conformance manifest from the retired X402Backend, enabling the execution of 14 deterministic tests against the live X402SupportedView. The addition of these tests ensures a robust regression guard for the facilitator's advertised capabilities, maintaining compliance with the industry-standard contract. The changes include a new manifest and a dedicated test module, both of which have passed verification.

items.title: Retire X402Backend and Update Documentation in Index 🚀
items.summary: The standalone X402Backend has been retired, with documentation updated to reflect that x402 is now integrated into PlatformGateway. Key changes include marking the old route as superseded and removing the local X402Backend directory, which was never deployed. The core-v2 conformance suite has been successfully ported to Gateway CI.

items.title: Streamline x402 Payment Lane to V2 Only in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the x402 payment lane to exclusively use the V2 specification, removing the legacy V1 `X-Payment` compatibility. Key changes include dropping the `X-Payment` branch in the authentication process, ensuring that both the body and header now align with V2 requirements. New tests have been added to validate the V2-only functionality, enhancing clarity and reducing potential client confusion.

items.title: Streamline Short-Drama Skill with Key Fixes in Platform Service 🎬
items.summary: This update focuses on cleaning up the SKILL.md file by removing outdated references and redundant narrative elements, ensuring the integrity of essential API details remains intact. Key changes include fixing a dangling reference from a previous PR and deleting unnecessary historical prose, resulting in a net reduction of 8 lines. The overall functionality and testing coverage have been preserved, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Streamlined Story Governance with Deterministic Checks in Platform Service 🎭
items.summary: This update replaces the complex governance framework for short-drama story validation with a simplified, deterministic script. The new `check_story.py` ensures structural integrity of stories while reducing code complexity by over 2,300 lines. Key improvements include enhanced validation rules and a focus on maintaining the narrative spine without external dependencies.

items.title: Refine npm audit for production dependencies in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the npm audit command in the extension's package.json to include the --omit=dev flag, ensuring that only production dependencies are audited. This change prevents unnecessary failures due to high-severity vulnerabilities in development tooling, which do not impact the packaged extension. The audit now reports zero vulnerabilities, maintaining the integrity of the CI process.

items.title: Streamline x402 to Gateway V2, Retire X402Backend in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update consolidates the x402 functionality into the Gateway V2, effectively retiring the previously unused X402Backend. Key changes include the addition of a live V2 interop probe and a comprehensive architecture teardown document. The transition ensures that industry-standard V2 agents can now process payments seamlessly, enhancing overall system efficiency.

items.title: Update autoprefixer to latest version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the autoprefixer package from version 10.5.2 to 10.5.4. Key improvements include fixes for prefixed rule duplication and enhancements to the gradient and bracket parsers, ensuring better CSS compatibility and performance.
